property_summary: For any inputs, C always calls the callee function with the selector for transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so the recorder observes calls to transferFrom with the provided arguments); the mutant instead calls transfer(address,address,uint256) and thus for some inputs the observed selector/decoded arguments differ.
change_summary: Change the encoded selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, altering which function selector is invoked and thus observed behavior.
